_about: AB-10 re-issue request for montecarlo ambient-issue: the accepted NOT-VALIDATED spectrum re-issued as validated v1 with unchanged weights. Paths are relative to this file.
ReferenceName: UNSCEAR 2000 Report Vol. I Annex B Table 6 (dose coefficients from ICRU Report 53 and Saito & Jacob, Radiat. Prot. Dosim. 58 (1995) 29-45)
ReferenceStatusOld: NOT VALIDATED: awaiting the author decision on the UNSCEAR ratios (AB-4d).
ReferenceStatusNew: VALIDATED by author decision AB-10 (2026-10-04): air kerma at 1 m per Bq/kg agrees with UNSCEAR 2000 within the accepted +-3 % model-comparison band (a model comparison, not a statistical test); weights, table and NotIncluded unchanged from terrestrial-unscear2000-v1-NOT-VALIDATED (see Validation).

Validation.Kind: model comparison, not a statistical test
Validation.Note: Band chosen by the author after seeing the ratios. The gaps from 1 are many MC standard errors wide: a model-to-model difference (UNSCEAR's coefficients come from another calculation; decay-data versions; soil composition); the model's own omissions (transitions without evaluated intensities, bremsstrahlung, K fluorescence) would raise, not lower, the kerma. Uncollided line fluence agreed with the analytic half-space kernel within 6 SE in every tested cell (turn 6). High-energy limits (AB-3 / TODO-31) unchanged.
